name: Micronaut Core 5.2.23
body:
<!-- Release notes generated using configuration in .github/release.yml at 5.2.x -->

## What's Changed

Micronaut Core 5.2.23 is a patch release with security fixes and framework improvements. It addresses 38 GitHub Security Advisories.

## 🚨 Security fixes

### HTTP server and routing

- Isolate listeners and protect id-less management endpoints: [GHSA-c856-m48r-3gpc](https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/security/advisories/GHSA-c856-m48r-3gpc).
- Harden the CORS localhost guard against spoofed forwarded headers and IPv6 loopback `Host` values: [GHSA-72p5-8f28-xwp2](https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/security/advisories/GHSA-72p5-8f28-xwp2), [GHSA-fv5h-6pjp-g363](https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/security/advisories/GHSA-fv5h-6pjp-g363).
- Keep filters and route arguments from seeing different values for the same request: [GHSA-hm9j-m8h9-32v9](https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/security/advisories/GHSA-hm9j-m8h9-32v9).
- Keep request-terminated events and pooled client continuations in their own propagated context: [GHSA-xh4x-vj47-4px7](https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/security/advisories/GHSA-xh4x-vj47-4px7).
- Apply `@JsonView` to wrapped bodies, SSE events, and fallback writers: [GHSA-432j-9h93-pv45](https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/security/advisories/GHSA-432j-9h93-pv45).
- Escape control characters in access log values: [GHSA-wgxm-75ph-q27x](https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/security/advisories/GHSA-wgxm-75ph-q27x).
- Evaluate CORS preflight requests against the route serving the requested method: [GHSA-c79q-p83r-9vpm](https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/security/advisories/GHSA-c79q-p83r-9vpm).
- Bound request parsing work and keep blocking calls off the event loop: [GHSA-jfwr-qrpq-5g48](https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/security/advisories/GHSA-jfwr-qrpq-5g48).
- Prevent TLS listeners from serving plaintext while their SSL context is pending or has failed: [GHSA-35qg-26hc-qr84](https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/security/advisories/GHSA-35qg-26hc-qr84).
- Run route-scoped filters for every request reaching the route: [GHSA-p72j-v3qh-v5mm](https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/security/advisories/GHSA-p72j-v3qh-v5mm).
- Match filters against the path used by the router and static resource resolver: [GHSA-wcgp-mmwm-x2x2](https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/security/advisories/GHSA-wcgp-mmwm-x2x2).
- Reset HTTP/3 request streams that fail or close early: [GHSA-6v2q-5rcc-qfmc](https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/security/advisories/GHSA-6v2q-5rcc-qfmc).
- Enforce form limits across part headers, `Content-Length`, and tiny chunks: [GHSA-h2j4-vr48-c4vv](https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/security/advisories/GHSA-h2j4-vr48-c4vv).
- Ensure context-path filters cover function and WebSocket routes and prefix-colliding paths: [GHSA-gj4v-r6x3-66jp](https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/security/advisories/GHSA-gj4v-r6x3-66jp).
- Bound caches keyed by request-controlled values: [GHSA-jj39-pp85-xj49](https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/security/advisories/GHSA-jj39-pp85-xj49).
- Correct connection lifecycle, idle-timeout, and HTTP/2 response framing behavior: [GHSA-82w6-g6gh-pjrv](https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/security/advisories/GHSA-82w6-g6gh-pjrv).
- Release request body buffers and stop late-body loops when a route does not consume its body: [GHSA-wjxw-jjr4-4mqr](https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/security/advisories/GHSA-wjxw-jjr4-4mqr), [GHSA-8rrh-x2ch-p2vv](https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/security/advisories/GHSA-8rrh-x2ch-p2vv).
- Release response buffers, streams, and compressors when responses are discarded or clients disconnect: [GHSA-5g2v-x779-wr6w](https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/security/advisories/GHSA-5g2v-x779-wr6w).
- Prevent classpath resource resolution from following symlinks outside the configured base: [GHSA-5hmw-vf9q-xqhv](https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/security/advisories/GHSA-5hmw-vf9q-xqhv).
- Close `StreamedFile` input streams when returning `304 Not Modified`: [GHSA-mjjj-6mx9-p8px](https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/security/advisories/GHSA-mjjj-6mx9-p8px).
- Bound compressed request processing and reject truncated compressed bodies: [GHSA-2j79-mgc9-v76r](https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/security/advisories/GHSA-2j79-mgc9-v76r), [GHSA-hgj7-52cp-647p](https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/security/advisories/GHSA-hgj7-52cp-647p).
- Fix multipart parser hangs and direct-memory leaks on malformed, truncated, or over-limit bodies: [GHSA-88m6-wjjg-mc7g](https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/security/advisories/GHSA-88m6-wjjg-mc7g).
- Fail in-flight HTTP/2 request bodies and release buffered data when their stream closes: [GHSA-4j6j-v86m-5xv7](https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/security/advisories/GHSA-4j6j-v86m-5xv7).

### HTTP clients

- Bound HTTP client response sizes and timeouts for stalled bodies: [GHSA-j3jr-9qw4-m252](https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/security/advisories/GHSA-j3jr-9qw4-m252).
- Release client buffers and connections after malicious or failing upstream responses: [GHSA-fr2f-ww99-xgcc](https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/security/advisories/GHSA-fr2f-ww99-xgcc).
- Clear stale `Content-Length` state and prevent unsafe connection reuse after decode failures: [GHSA-wv7m-pmvh-98h9](https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/security/advisories/GHSA-wv7m-pmvh-98h9).
- Isolate client cookies and credentials and prevent unsafe request-construction behavior: [GHSA-mfrv-8fw9-56vq](https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/security/advisories/GHSA-mfrv-8fw9-56vq).
- Bound JSON stream element size and processing work: [GHSA-5pxm-5867-gjc9](https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/security/advisories/GHSA-5pxm-5867-gjc9).
- Honor configured header filters on cross-origin redirects in the JDK HTTP client: [GHSA-9mfm-8wr5-m838](https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/security/advisories/GHSA-9mfm-8wr5-m838).
- Do not forward request framing or hop-by-hop headers from relayed requests in the JDK HTTP client: [GHSA-64w5-89v4-549v](https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/security/advisories/GHSA-64w5-89v4-549v).

### WebSockets and server-sent events

- Harden WebSocket upgrade handling: [GHSA-gpxf-v9p3-4hh5](https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/security/advisories/GHSA-gpxf-v9p3-4hh5).
- Close WebSocket connections after sending a close frame, including when the endpoint has no `@OnClose` handler: [GHSA-38pj-464p-88jf](https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/security/advisories/GHSA-38pj-464p-88jf).
- Bound WebSocket inbound work and outbound waits: [GHSA-973f-vvmg-r76v](https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/security/advisories/GHSA-973f-vvmg-r76v).
- Release WebSocket messages whose decoding fails: [GHSA-xccf-9g9p-4q66](https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/security/advisories/GHSA-xccf-9g9p-4q66).
- Neutralize line breaks in server-sent event fields: [GHSA-596x-f5j6-xvhc](https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/security/advisories/GHSA-596x-f5j6-xvhc).

## Improvements and fixes

- Keep `@InjectScope` beans scoped to each creation, including nested and concurrent creations.
- Keep runtime proxy target resolutions isolated, and deliver reactive signals with the propagated context bound.
- Make propagated context entry and exit cheaper, and restore the previous context even when a thread element fails.
- Prevent environment lookups from failing while the environment is starting.
- Choose the highest-weight acceptable compression algorithm and never select an algorithm assigned `q=0`.
- Avoid duplicate processing of executable methods by deprecated method processors.
- Resolve `@Replaces` chains and allow replacements to satisfy the qualifiers of the beans they replace.
- Resolve placeholders in `@Executable` annotation members separately for each application context.
- Preserve Python object identity during conversion and support type-use annotation metadata without a native originating element.
- Read Kotlin annotation defaults from the compiled annotation class when the current processing round has no usage.

## Other changes

- Improve test compatibility and stability for current JDK and Netty behavior, including retrying an external TLS test when the remote test service times out.

[Full changelog](https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/compare/v5.2.22...v5.2.23)
